dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jan 20 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000rqrt](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000rqrt) Magnitude 5.9 earthquake at 89.957 depth occurred on Jan 20 2026 23km E of Madang. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -5.2807 longitude 145.9951. It impacted 86018 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
